check_in_zh: 今天练了吗？在 App 里点打卡，连续打卡满 7 天解锁新场景。

dialogue.en: Thanks for grabbing coffee. How's the Drova backfill going?
dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你出来喝咖啡。Drova 的 backfill 进展怎么样？

dialogue.en: Going well! And honestly, your tip about partitioning by event time saved me hours.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: 先感谢对方之前给过的具体帮助，这是 peer 关系里的黄金开场
dialogue.zh: 挺顺利的！说真的，你上次说的按 event time 分区的建议，帮我省了好几个小时。

dialogue.en: Oh nice, glad that helped. It's one of those things you only learn the hard way.
dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.zh: 哦太好了，能帮上忙真好。这种都是吃过亏才学到的。

dialogue.en: Totally. Hey, I wanted to pick your brain on something — how did you handle the consumer lag during your migration?
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: pick your brain 是请教的地道说法，比 can I ask you 更随意亲切
dialogue.zh: 确实。哎，想请教你个事——你当时迁移的时候 consumer lag 是怎么处理的？

dialogue.en: Good question. We ended up doubling the partitions and it smoothed out. I can send you our runbook if you want.
dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.zh: 问得好。我们最后把 partition 翻倍就平滑了。想要的话我可以把我们的 runbook 发你。

dialogue.en: That'd be amazing. I'd really appreciate it.
dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.en: Of course. So how are you finding the team so far? Settling in okay?
dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.zh: 别客气。你来团队这么久，感觉怎么样？适应了吗？

dialogue.en: Yeah, everyone's been super welcoming. The tribal knowledge is real though — half my questions are like, who even knows this?
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: tribal knowledge 是团队里口口相传的知识；自嘲式幽默拉近距离
dialogue.zh: 嗯，大家都很热情。不过 tribal knowledge 是真的多——我一半的问题都是：这事到底谁知道啊？

dialogue.en: Ha! That's every new person here. It took me six months to figure out who owns what.
dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！每个新人都这样。我花了半年才搞清楚谁负责什么。

dialogue.en: That makes me feel better. Alright, I should let you get back to it — thanks again for the runbook!
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: I should let you get back to it 是 peer 闲聊收尾的体贴说法
dialogue.zh: 听你这么说我就放心了。好了，不耽误你了——runbook 的事再谢一次！

key_phrases.en: Your tip about partitioning saved me hours.
key_phrases.note: 感谢要具体，对方才记得住、才开心
key_phrases.zh: 你上次说的分区建议帮我省了好几个小时。

key_phrases.en: I wanted to pick your brain on something.
key_phrases.note: 请教的地道说法，随意亲切

key_phrases.en: That'd be amazing. I'd really appreciate it.
key_phrases.note: 接受帮助时的热情回应

key_phrases.en: The tribal knowledge is real though.
key_phrases.note: 自嘲式幽默，拉近和老员工的距离
key_phrases.zh: 不过 tribal knowledge 是真的多。

key_phrases.en: I should let you get back to it.
key_phrases.note: peer 闲聊收尾的体贴说法

practice_zh: 跟读 5 分钟：打开 TTS 逐句跟读，重点练 pick your brain 的连读
替换练习 5 分钟：把 partitioning tip 换成一位同事真实帮过你的事，大声说 3 遍
完整模拟 5 分钟：从 Thanks for grabbing coffee 开始，一个人演完 10 句，注意感谢要具体
roleplay_zh: 假设你约了一位 peer 喝咖啡。用英文聊 3 分钟：感谢他之前给过的一个具体帮助、请教一个技术问题、聊一句对团队的感受、体贴地收尾。
scene_zh: 和 peer 工程师 Priya 的 coffee chat。目标是感谢她之前的帮助、请教一个迁移中的技术问题、聊聊对团队的感受，建立更深的 peer 关系。
title: 1:1 Coffee Chat with a Peer
